US.name: Field mint
US.citation: Easyscape; Wikipedia. Genus Mentha is taxonomically difficult; the massive commercial 'Japanese mint'/menthol-crop industry across CN/JP/KR/IN is documented (US plant patent PP21053) as botanically Mentha canadensis, a separate accepted species per Kew POWO, not true M. arvensis - those four candidate countries were deliberately excluded rather than assumed
